an4.105:1.8: Evam eva kho bhikkhave cattāro 'me ambūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.105:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo āmo hoti pakkavaṇṇī?
an4.105:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ . . . pe . . .
an4.105:2.3: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti . . . pe . . .
an4.105:2.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo āmo hoti pakkavaṇṇī,
an4.105:2.5: seyyathāpi taṃ bhikkhave ambaṃ āmaṃ pakkavaṇṇi,
an4.105:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo pakko hoti āmavaṇṇī?
an4.105:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa na pāsādikam hoti abhikkantaṃ . . . pe . . .
an4.105:3.3: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . .
an4.105:3.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo pakko hoti āmavaṇṇī,
an4.105:3.5: seyyathāpi taṃ bhikkhave ambaṃ pakkaṃ āmavaṇṇi,
an4.105:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo āmo hoti āmavaṇṇī?
an4.105:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa na pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ . . . pe . . .
an4.105:4.3: so idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti . . . pe . . .
an4.105:4.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo āmo hoti āmavaṇṇī,
an4.105:4.5: seyyathāpi taṃ bhikkhave ambaṃ āmaṃ āmavaṇṇi,
an4.105:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo pakko hoti pakkavaṇṇī?
an4.105:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa pāsādikaṃ hoti abhikkantaṃ . . . pe . . .
an4.105:5.3: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . .
an4.105:5.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo pakko hoti pakkavaṇṇī,
an4.105:5.5: seyyathāpi taṃ bhikkhave ambaṃ pakkaṃ pakkavaṇṇi,
an4.105:5.7: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro ambūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin
